The primary focus of Conformer-2 is to improve the recognition of proper nouns, alphanumerics, and noise robustness. It follows the scaling laws proposed in DeepMind's Chinchilla paper and leverages a massive amount of training data. One notable feature of Conformer-2 is its use of model ensembling, which reduces variance and enhances performance. Despite its larger size, Conformer-2 exhibits improved speed and processing compared to its predecessor. In real-world applications, Conformer-2 demonstrates significant enhancements in user-oriented metrics, particularly in alphanumerics, proper noun error rate, and noise robustness. name: Classifyai
short_description: ClassifyAI is a platform that enables users to create, generate, and classify JSON models using OpenAI's API.
description: ClassifyAI is a middleware that simplifies the process of working with AI models. It allows users to call AI models and retrieve structured JSON Objects instead of plain text. To use ClassifyAI, users create and configure a JSON Object that specifies the structure of the information they want to retrieve. They then make a request to the ClassifyAI API, providing the input data and any relevant context. In return, they receive a filled JSON Object with the defined keys, containing the structured information they need. For example, without ClassifyAI, an AI model may generate a plain text review about the BIKE 3000. With ClassifyAI, users can define a JSON Object to retrieve specific information from the review, such as the overall sentiment or specific features mentioned. ClassifyAI also offers pre-defined global JSON Objects that cover various topics and provide structured information ready for use.
